call_points.text: FY27 capex guided at about ₹400 Cr, spread across verticals with no separate EV or ICE split.
Lifetime order book of about ₹2,500 Cr added in Q1FY27, split across divisions, ICE and EV, domestic and export.
Group capacity utilisation running at about 77-80%, varying by plant and product line.
Turntide motor controller SOP expected in October-November; lines are set up and under testing.
Sunroof business SOP on track for Q2FY27; customer trials approved in the first attempt.
Commodity, labour and freight inflation partly offset by efficiency; index-linked pass-through has a one-to-two quarter lag.
Share of profit from associates fell to ₹18 Cr from ₹31.5 Cr on Flash depreciation and a weaker Furukawa contribution.
Management targets long-term vision of ₹17,500 crores top-line by FY2030 with 12.5% EBITDA margin.
Lifetime order book registered ₹10,000 crores for FY26, with 20% coming from exports.
Raw material cost pressures from copper, zinc, and aluminum are managed through pass-through contracts.

Fire at the Noida (Plot D-6-11, Sector-59) plant on May 30, 2026 around 4:15 p.m.; no casualties, stock and plant insured, loss quantum and production impact under assessment.

Agganga Private Limited, incorporated 2025, had nil turnover and PAT of ₹0.03 lakh as on 31.03.2026; Minda will hold 26% on completion for up to ₹112.20 lakh in cash.

timeline.summary: CRISIL upgraded Minda Corporation and Minda Instruments' long-term bank facilities rating to CRISIL AA/Stable.
2026-05-12: Minda Corporation filed the monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26 confirming full utilization of ₹105.19 Cr warrant proceeds for debt repayment.
Minda Corporation Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹0.80 per equity share (₹2 face value) on May 22, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,703.81 Cr (+29.0% YoY), net profit ₹124 Cr (+138.3% YoY).
Minda Corporation reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,704 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹6,185 Cr alongside a final dividend recommendation.
Minda Corporation signed an amendment agreement with VAST on May 22, 2026, securing control over joint venture company Minda Vast Access Systems.
Minda Corporation reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,704 Cr (+29% YoY) and recommended a final dividend of ₹0.80 per share.
Minda Corporation reported a fire at its Noida (Sector-59) plant on May 30, 2026 with no injuries; loss and production impact not yet assessed, plant insured.
14-Oct-2026: Signed a Share Subscription Agreement to buy 26% of solar project developer Agganga Private Limited for up to ₹1.12 Cr, to cut power cost.

watchlist.response: Ajay Agarwal called it temporary, citing commodity and labour costs, and said Flash should be back on track in one or two quarters.
